name: Rugelach
summary: Cream cheese dough. Tender, tangy, rolled around filling.

steps.text: Beat butter and cream cheese smooth, then add flour.
Chill in discs at least three hours.
Roll thin, cut wedges, spread filling and roll from the wide end.
Chill the shaped pieces before baking.

bake.notes: Chilling shaped pieces stops the filling running out.

notes: The dough is unworkable unless properly cold.
